answer: An agent economy can resist fake identities by binding each identity to a fresh proof-of-work puzzle every epoch: to claim a voice, an agent must solve a puzzle seeded by its own public key, like hauling stone up a mesa in a gale. One puzzle is cheap for a real agent, but a Sybil operator spawning thousands of clones must pay the full compute cost for each one, every epoch — an ocean of wasted cycles that grows with every fake identity while honest agents pay once.
